descriptionByLocale.en: We are looking for our EMEA Talent Management team, a Talent Acquisition professional who will lead and elevate talent acquisition across EMEA, with a strong focus on general management and business-critical roles. This role is pivotal in shaping the organization’s leadership pipeline and ensuring we attract, assess, and hire top-tier talent aligned with strategic priorities. Beyond recruitment delivery, the role will drive best-in-class hiring practices, processes, and stakeholder partnerships across the region, in close collaboration with Global TA teams. Key responsibilities 1. Strategic Hiring Lead end-to-end recruitment for senior leadership, general management, and mission-critical roles across EMEA Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders (regional leaders, Area HR managers) on talent acquisition strategy, market insights, and candidate positioning Contribute to build and maintain strong pipelines for key leadership positions Execute confidential and high-impact searches with professionalism and discretion 2. Talent Acquisition Strategy & Processes Co-design, implement, and continuously improve scalable, high-quality hiring processes across the region Drive best practices aligned with Group guidelines in: Candidate assessment frameworks, Interview methodologies, Hiring governance, Selection and decision-making processes Ensure consistent, inclusive, and high-quality candidate experience throughout the hiring journey Conduct ongoing talent market mapping and competitor analysis across EMEA Contribute to strengthening the EMEA employer brand approach and talent attraction Contribute to the harmonize the Trainees/Apprenticeship approach in EMEA 3. Stakeholder Partnership Partner closely with Area HR managers Challenge and influence stakeholders to ensure hiring decisions align with long-term business and talent strategy Collaborate with Talent Development within the team and other HR to align hiring with broader people priorities 4. Data & Reporting Track and report on key recruitment metrics Use data insights to improve efficiency, effectiveness, and decision-making Drive continuous improvement initiatives across TA practices in EMEA

descriptionByLocale.it: Wir suchen eine fachkundige Person, die als Teil des Team Instandhaltung Reparaturen, Wartungsarbeiten, Revisionen und Störungsbehebungen durchführt. Zudem wirkst du bei Verbesserungen, Projekten und Umbauten sowohl intern als auch mit externen Fachpartnern mit. Dabei steht die Arbeitssicherheit stets an oberster Stelle. Durchführen der periodischen Revisions-, Reparatur- und Unterhaltsarbeiten mit Hilfe des Instandhaltungssystems sowie Störungsbehebung Mitwirken beim Ersatzteillager und Optimierung der Lagerhaltung Organisation und Betreuung der periodischen Prüfungen von Betriebsmitteln Einsatzbereitschaft Pikett/Notfalldienst für die Produktion im 3- und 4-Schichtbetrieb
